title: Rollout confirmation overlay — visual redlines, copy refinement, and QA handoff
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and finalize the confirmation/affirmation overlay shown after a rollout action (start, pause, rollback). Deliver visual redlines, final copy, and accessibility guidance so engineering can implement a11y-compliant overlays with clear success states and undo affordances. This ticket covers visual iteration, motion spec, focus management, microcopy, and QA checklists for the Console rollout flow.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master frames updated with final visual redlines and exported tokens
Motion spec includes 2 states (confirm, final state) with duration and easing documented
ARIA roles and focus trap guidance added to the handoff notes
Copy approved by PM and localized variables flagged
Design QA checklist created and reviewed with QA; no high-severity UX regressions in dev review
decision_log: Key decisions: 1) Use subtle upward motion with 160ms duration and 12px translateY for the affirmation card to feel lightweight; 2) Keep primary CTA label as 'View rollout' instead of 'Open' to surface the rollback path; 3) Provide a secondary 'Undo' affordance that times out after 10s and is keyboard-focusable; 4) Use role='status' for transient confirmation and role='dialog' for persistent inspection mode (when the overlay includes links to rollout details).
comments: 2026-02-25 Maya Chen: Initial discovery — sketched three overlay variants during design spike. Noted engineering constraints around z-index stacking with existing notifications component. Uploaded rough frames to Figma and linked to rollout flow.

2026-03-01 Ravi Kapoor (PM): Reviewed copy. Prefer 'View rollout' CTA to increase discoverability of rollback controls. Also requested that the overlay be dismissible with ESC and that an optional analytics ping be emitted for 'Undo' clicks.

2026-03-03 Accessibility review (Lena Ortiz): Redlines added — must include keyboard trap when overlay has form controls, ensure contrast ratio >=4.5:1 for critical labels, provide visible focus ring on 'Undo' button, and ensure announcer text for screen readers uses aria-live polite for non-blocking confirmations.

2026-03-06 Design critique: Stakeholders (Eng lead: Omar Vasquez, PM: Ravi Kapoor, Design: Maya Chen) agreed on animation and copy. Engineering raised an implementation question re: timeout persistence across route changes; decision to scope timeout cancellation to successful navigation only.

2026-03-08 Handoff: Uploaded redlines page with token mapping, exported PNGs for QA, updated component props table with 'dismissOnNavigate' boolean and 'undoTimeoutMs' default 10000. Added note to console docs describing telemetry event 'rollout_undo_clicked'.

2026-03-10 Lena Ortiz: Prepared Design QA checklist and test cases. Requested dev review of focus management PR before final sign-off. Marking In Review and awaiting engineering acceptance and accessibility verification.
